title: [DocDB] Segmentation Fault in MvccManager::SafeTimeForFollower
body:
Jira Link: [DB-10780](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-10780)
### Description

Tried on `2.23.0.0-b132`. This is a CDC case, and looks like a regression.

![Profile (6)](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/assets/109518123/104f55d9-065e-49e4-ba8b-272bd368947e)
